items.title: Land isolated-clone runtime
items.exit_criteria: Met: main installs, tests and packages without a sibling TheHub checkout; CI asserts the checkout is isolated.

items.title: Reconcile workspace policy
items.exit_criteria: Met: superseded by the isolated-clone runtime; one workspace policy remains.

items.title: Supersede or refresh GUI parity candidate
items.exit_criteria: Met: the parity ratchet runs on main.

items.title: Run recurring source discovery and candidate intake
items.exit_criteria: real_candidate_rows > 0 from a reproducible governed run that records source accounting and does not modify master; the CAND-0000 placeholder row is removed.

items.title: Grow corpus through reviewed promotion
items.exit_criteria: master_rows > 470, each added row promoted individually with a validation and lineage receipt; master_created_months has a month after 2026-06.

items.title: Record coordinate provenance and backfill municipality
items.exit_criteria: coordinate_provenance_row_count equals coordinate_pair_count (each pair has source, method, precision and review state); every case at location_confidence <= 0.6 is resolved or marked unresolvable; municipality is present or explicitly unresolvable for every case, with derived values labelled as derived.

items.title: Bind master cases to registered sources
items.exit_criteria: source_family_present and source_citation_present rise from 120 and 4 for every case whose source reference adjudicates unambiguously; ties stay REVIEW_TIE and are not written; DISCOVERY_ONLY count falls from 190.

items.title: Adjudicate manifestation candidates and seed research ledgers
items.exit_criteria: Each of the 38 manifestation candidates has an adjudication (same event, distinct, or unresolved); research_queue and topics are non-empty.

items.title: Clear the pull-request backlog
items.exit_criteria: No pull request older than 30 days is open without a recorded disposition; main is branch-protected.
